rv.q: O Flanagan recounts true tales from her life with an openness and intimacy that invites the audience to lean in and listen.
This performer is unusually winning, and she sends the crowd out on notes of positivity and regard for our fellow humans.
Many people will be positively glad to make Flanagan’s big-hearted acquaintance.
The performance was deeply engaging, philosophically stimulating, and absolutely wondrous.
Give yourself a gift and go see this woman who believes in magic.
O Flanagan emerges confidently and, for approximately 75 minutes, holds the audience's rapt attention.

cn.t: Critics praise O Flanagan's intimate, life-affirming storytelling that moves audiences through bare-bones simplicity and personal authenticity, though some find the no-frills approach more therapeutic than theatrically ambitious.
